_comment: Per-peripheral SystemRDL registry (tools/rdl/README.md). This file is the ONE place that says which .rdl file describes a peripheral, which addrmap in it is the block, which generate.py PeripheralTemplate its registers belong to, and where those registers come from: registerSource "rdl" means generate.py BUILDS the template from the description and carries no register data of its own; "generator" means the template is still hand-written, which since report R7 no peripheral is -- the four whose register set or field geometry is a function of the configuration are SystemRDL components with PARAMETERS, and the `parameters` field names them; "none" means the block is not a memory-mapped peripheral at all. rdl:false switches a peripheral off entirely. //platform/common:rdl_vs_generator_test grades every entry against the generated register map, which for a "generator" entry is a real comparison and for an "rdl" entry is the self-consistency check that the loader and the emitters agree.

UARTx.note: The pilot. Its .rdl is byte-equivalent to the UARTx PeripheralTemplate in generate.py, descriptions included.

GPIOx.note: hdl/common/periph/GPIO.vhd, six 8-pin ports. PxOUTT / PxIF / PxTASK are num_pins wide in the RTL, not 32, and the RstValPx* reset generics differ per port.

SPIx.note: hdl/common/periph/SPI.vhd. SPIxFOS exists only on SPI0 (ENABLE_EXTENDED_MEM); any access to SPIxRX clears SPITCIF.

TIMERx.note: hdl/common/periph/TIMER.vhd. TIMxVAL has no byte lanes: any enabled lane writes the whole word.

SYSTEM.note: hdl/common/periph/SYSTEM.vhd. DCO0BIAS/DCO1BIAS reset to 0x800; WDTCR writes need the WDTPASS unlock window.

NPU.note: hdl/common/periph/NPU.vhd MMR block. NPUTHINK is a separate flop written with the raw bit and cleared by NpuDone.

PWRCTRL.note: hdl/common/pwr_ctrl.vhd. Carries TASKWKM (word 7), a register generate.py does not model at all.
PWRCTRL.parameters: PARAMETERISED (R7): NHARTS. The guards VESTA_PWR_MULTIWORD / VESTA_PWR_MIDWORDS carry the PWRSR word count, which a parameter cannot: a SystemRDL array dimension must be greater than zero, and the one-word register is named PWRSR while the multi-word ones are PWRSR0/1/2.

QSPIx.note: hdl/common/periph/QSPI.vhd. SR is slot 5, not slot 1; a lane-0 QSPIxCMD write is the sole launch.

I2Cx.note: hdl/common/periph/I2C.vhd. I2CxAR resets to the default_SAD generic: 0x79 on I2C0, 0x23 on I2C1.

CLINT.note: hdl/common/clint.vhd. Every MTIMECMP word resets to all-ones so mtip starts low.
CLINT.parameters: PARAMETERISED (R7): NHARTS, NHARTS_WORD (the count spelled, as _spelled() prints it), MTIME_W, CMP_W. MSIPh is a register array; the MTIMECMPhL/H pair is a regfile array on an 8-byte stride, because two interleaved register arrays overlap.

MUTEX.note: hdl/common/mutex_bank.vhd. A READ claims the mutex; the owner field is MW+1 = 4 bits, not 32.
MUTEX.parameters: PARAMETERISED (R7): NMUTEX, MW (= mcu_vhd masterW()), NHARTS. The owner markers are a parameterised run of value descriptions, because a SystemRDL enum is a static type whose member values must fit the field and 32 harts need 6 bits in a 4-bit field.

NFCx.note: hdl/common/periph/NFC.vhd. Three non-zero resets: CR 0x1000, CFG 0x44, TIM 0x088004D4.

RTCx.note: hdl/common/periph/RTC.vhd. SEC/SUB write staged values and read the live counter.

PWMx.note: hdl/common/periph/PWM.vhd. Slots 4, 5 and 7 are reserved headroom and read 0.

OWx.note: hdl/common/periph/OneWire.vhd. An OWxCMD write snapshots OWODS and OWxTX into the descriptor and launches.

DMAx.note: hdl/common/periph/DMA.vhd. CRC resets to 0xFFFF; CnSRC/CnDST/CnLEN are full 32-bit stores; GO/ABORT read 0.

TRNGx.note: hdl/common/periph/TRNG.vhd. TRNGxDR is the library's one read-consume register.

I2CTx.note: hdl/common/periph/I2CTarget.vhd. An I2CTxTX write loads and launches.

EVFAB.note: hdl/common/periph/EVFAB.vhd. EVFCAP is the hardwired constant 0x010A1008; CHENSET/CHENCLR are w1s/w1c aliases of CHEN.

IRQROUTER.note: hdl/common/irq_router.vhd. CLAIM (word 512) has no storage: a read claims, a write completes.
IRQROUTER.parameters: PARAMETERISED (R7): NHARTS, VECTORS, UMSB, UTOP, XMSB. The guards VESTA_IRQR_NO_XWORDS / VESTA_IRQR_U_NARROW carry the two shapes below 97 interrupt sources; no configuration emitted today defines either.

DEBUG.registerSourceReason: The Debug Module is not memory-mapped: its registers live in the DMI address space, reachable only through the JTAG DTM, so there is no generate.py PeripheralTemplate for them and no register-index row. The description is compiled and exported (//tools/rdl:peakrdl_export_test) and is linked from the debug chapter as its own table.
DEBUG.note: hdl/common/dbg/*.vhd. DMI space, not the memory map.
